item.tib: 'phrul ngag bden pa'i ming don rnam bshad
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni 'phrul ngag bden pa'i bstan pa la shes nas thob pa'i dad pa'i blo mig grol ba khod spungs sngags rigs kyi rgyud du byung ba'i btsun pa bskal (skal) bzang bstan rgyal lam gzhan phan rgya mtshos nye grogs rnams kyis ched du bskul ba'i ngor/ sba rgyal dkar mo ljongs kyi gnas mdun me tog sna tshogs pa'i spang thang gis brgyan pa'i ljon shing gi drung du dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams 'ga' zhig la bris pa'o//
